description: Tracked, iterable registry of disposable-save cohorts and the TBG-owned canonical disposable save. Individual save bytes and absolute paths stay machine-local. Exact save/game version compatibility is delegated to the canonical save-compatibility harness instead of duplicated here.

compatibility.note: A disposable-looking filename is never sufficient mutation authority. Automated reuse requires the canonical save-compatibility gate to classify the exact save bytes against the current game version, and newly cloned owned saves are re-observed before pinning.

ownedCanonical.role: canonical TBG-owned disposable save; DevSaveResolver prefix mirror
ownedCanonical.note: When a fresh owned save is needed, the updater clones an already exact-version automation-eligible disposable save, reclassifies the new bytes, and only then records the active pin.

cohorts.purpose: Canonical dev-start disposable save for QuickStart/priority-engine automation.
Agent-generated disposable saves created by the updater for isolated automation runs.
Operator personal, scratch, and named-milestone saves. Never eligible for automated mutation merely because of age, calendar year, or location.

proofBoundary: Registry membership classifies save role only. Automated mutation additionally requires the canonical exact-version save-compatibility gate. Neither classification proves launcher success, in-game load, campaign readiness, movement, trade, or live runtime behavior.
